TokenBudgetBasis.input_scale: Five unique requests; one local Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B query batch; each request must expose exactly 96 unique union candidates and 16 unique final-review candidates over 1,888 source records and 34,199 compiled objects. Deterministic R7 then scans one raw sentence proposition unit at a time and compiles six typed target contracts.
TokenBudgetBasis.required_outputs: A single-use attempt receipt; immutable typed proposition classifications and stable digests; per-target source, compiled, union and final completeness and ranks; actor/counterparty/predicate/object/product/price/quantity/period/process/yield role-bound material coverage; residual external, 4B and reranker eligibility; and digest-bound private/public results through recursive exact-key and field-typed content validation with all downstream authority false.
TokenBudgetBasis.schema_burden: Bind 29 immutable inputs including R6 policy, public result, private result, attempt receipt and fresh failed audit plus all inherited R5/R4/R3 and R39 inputs; bind exact implementation commit/tree and 17 file hashes; enforce canonical exclusive output paths, disk capacity, one attempt, 5x96-to-16 rank permutations, zero-authority counters, exact replay/reprojection and recursive public schemas.
TokenBudgetBasis.materiality_quality_risk: False positives can combine different actors, clauses, sentences or objects; accept rumor, denial, suspension, capability, forecast, withdrawn, simulated, disputed or revoked statements; treat a non-Dell seller price as Dell ASP; or let unrelated entity, product, fiscal, currency or numeric text satisfy coverage. False negatives can discard valid Dell supplier sell-through, partnership or reported partner propositions. A permissive allowed public value can disclose credential-like, secret-like, encoded locator or traversal content. Any such error would corrupt external-source/ranking eligibility and later Evidence and report decisions.
TokenBudgetBasis.comparable_run_evidence: Immutable R6 used the same five-request 96-to-16 chain and one local 0.6B batch, but its fresh audit passed integrity/actual route and failed three P2 generalization findings. R7 author gates passed 151 targeted tests, 357 adjacent R1/R3/R4/R5/R6/R7 tests and one implementation-freeze full repository run of 1,726 passed plus 2 skipped and 2 existing warnings. A zero-call full-corpus preview over 1,888 sources and 34,199 objects took 223.188 seconds, retracted the cross-sentence CSpire non-Dell-seller ASP and restored an explicit Dell-NVIDIA partner proposition.
TokenBudgetBasis.reasoning_profile: Non-generative deterministic validation plus one local CUDA/FP16 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B query batch. R7 semantics and coverage operate on single raw-sentence proposition units with role-bound canonical anchors and field-typed public projection. No 4B embedding, reranker, generation model, Provider, external capture or network call is authorized; later challenger eligibility is measured only.
TokenBudgetBasis.stop_and_truncation: Fail before consumption on insufficient disk or any Git, parent, authority, audit, predecessor, implementation, runtime, input, output-path, policy digest, public-schema or collision drift. After the attempt receipt is created there is no same-attempt retry. Fail on anything other than five requests, one local batch, exact 96 and 16 unique rank permutations per request, or zero network, generation/model, provider, external, 4B, reranker, retry, mutation, promotion and closure counters. Never truncate a target, proposition role, material anchor, coverage, route, privacy or integrity output.
